subsection.name: Introduction
subsection.p:
The module-mylutece-database
provides a front office user authentication implementation for MyLutece based on local users stored in a database table.
This module enables comprehensive user account lifecycle management, including:

ul.li: Secure authentication with password management (encryption, history, expiration)
Protection against malicious login attempts (IP blocking, CAPTCHA)

subsection.p: The module integrates into Lutece's security architecture and uses the MyLutece system for front office authentication, while providing a complete administration interface for user management.

subsection.name: Configuration
subsection.p: The following properties are available in the mylutece-database.properties file:

ul.li: mylutece-database.service.name: Authentication service name (default: "Lutece Database Authentication Service")
paginator.users.itemsPerPage: Number of users per page (default: 50)
daemon.databaseAnonymizationDaemon.interval: Anonymization daemon execution interval in seconds (default: 86400 = 24h)

subsection.p: Two daemons are provided by the module:

ul.li: DatabaseAnonymizationDaemon: Daemon that anonymizes expired account data
DatabaseAccountLifeTimeDaemon: Daemon that manages account lifecycle (expiration notifications, deactivation of expired accounts)
